title: Railway Station Pe Chai-Snacks Stall: Licence Kaise Milta Hai Aur Kitna Kamate Hain?
description: No scraped reels this week, so this is reasoning. Licence-based businesses (gas agency, Amul parlour, wine shop) fit our best-performing 'dream business, hidden access' angle. Railway stalls are visible to everyone daily but the process is a mystery, and Railways' catering policy documents are public.
text:
HISAAB FACT SHEET: Railway platform stall licences (India)

**FLAG FOR SCRIPTWRITER (read first)**
- The hook's "₹20 chai" doesn't match the official rate card. The official station price is ₹5 for standard tea (150 ml) and ₹10 for tea-bag tea (150 ml). [https://etrain.info/page/standardmenu]
- Overcharging is real. At Una station, a salesman admitted the Railways rate was ₹5 but they charged ₹10 for "special" tea. [https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/himachal/passengers-being-overcharged-at-rly-station-canteen-570801]
- I found no official or reputable source on the take-home of a platform stall. The profit figures below are anecdotal or blog-level, and I've marked them that way.
- The ₹ per month figures marked "arithmetic" are my division of sourced numbers. They are not sourced facts.

**1. WHO GIVES THE RIGHT TO SELL (the licence route)**
- The law: Under Section 144 of the Railways Act, 1989, nobody may hawk or sell anything on any part of a railway without a licence from the railway administration. [https://indianrailways.gov.in/railwayboard/uploads/codesmanual/IRCTCD/TrafficCommericalDepartmentCh7_data.htm]
- Who runs it: Zonal Railways manage static units such as catering and milk stalls and trolleys. IRCTC handles Food Plazas, Food Courts and Fast Food Units. [https://bestcurrentaffairs.com/new-railway-catering-policy-released/]
- Method, 2017 policy: All minor catering units at every category of station are allotted through open tender. [https://bestcurrentaffairs.com/new-railway-catering-policy-released/]
- Method today: stalls are listed on the Indian Railways e-auction/tender portal. One example is "Auction for award of license... catering stall on Platform No.01 at Thuravur Railway Station of D category, in General Quota for a period of 5 years." [https://www.tenderdetail.com/State-tenders/delhi-tenders/catering-railway-tenders]
- The older Railway Code said the opposite. It said licences were awarded by calling applications and tender was not to be followed. That is outdated. [https://indianrailways.gov.in/railwayboard/uploads/codesmanual/IRCTCD/TrafficCommericalDepartmentCh7_data.htm]
- Tenure: Static units, except kitchen units and Food Plazas, get 5 years only. [https://bestcurrentaffairs.com/new-railway-catering-policy-released/] A Food Plaza licence can run 9 years. [https://www.businesstoday.in/latest/photo/want-to-run-a-shop-at-a-railway-station-heres-how-you-can-actually-get-one-555429-2026-09-15]
- Bidders compete on the licence fee. In a Sealdah division tender, the offer price quoted by the bidder is treated as the 1st year licence fee, if accepted. [https://www.railway-tenders.co.in/searchresult/?st=txt&sf=0&sd=sealdah-division-pay-and-use-toilet-tenders]
- Station categories: the Parliament committee report says stations are grouped into seven categories. [https://eparlib.sansad.in/bitstream/123456789/763828/1/16_Railways_21.pdf] Live tenders mention A1, A, C, D and F category stations. Some tenders also use NSG-1 to NSG-6 labels. [https://www.railway-tenders.co.in/searchresult/?st=txt&sf=0&sd=railway-food-stall-rajasthan-tenders]
- New in Nov 2025: Railways added a "Premium Brand Catering Outlet" category, so chains like McDonald's, KFC, Haldiram's can operate in stations. These go only through e-auction, with no nominations. [https://www.angelone.in/news/economy/indian-railways-to-permit-premium-single-brand-food-outlets-like-mcdonald-s-kfc-at-stations]

**2. UPFRONT COST TO GET IN**
- Tender document fee: ₹5,600 for a Chennai Egmore (A1) stall tender. [https://www.tendersontime.com/india/details/tender-provision-catering-stall-gmu-42-chennai-egmore-ms-under-a1-category-railway-station-lo-63b89e3/]
- Earnest money (EMD) on the same Egmore tender: ₹2,03,700. [https://www.tendersontime.com/india/details/tender-provision-catering-stall-gmu-42-chennai-egmore-ms-under-a1-category-railway-station-lo-63b89e3/]
- Annual licence fee is paid in advance. In one tender, the annual licence fee is payable in advance for each year. The licensee pays the annual fee within 15 days of receiving the letter of award. [https://www.tenderfiles.com/tenderdocuments/82026/8/120b1d15-562a-4c76-a326-645ece946811?FileName=PNU1SBD.pdf]
- A generic guide says a tender deposit of ₹40,000 to ₹3,00,000 depending on category. [https://zeenews.india.com/photos/business/railway-station-par-dukan-shop-kaise-khole-step-by-step-business-idea-2774710] RetailIntel repeats fees of ₹40,000 to ₹3 lakh. [https://retailintel.in/signal/irctc-outlines-tender-route-for-railway-station-retail-and-f-660f9c61] Both are secondary sources, not official.
- Unverified: an IIT Kanpur exam-prep page lists a ₹15,000 base annual fee, a ₹1 lakh deposit and a 12% royalty. [https://sathee.iitk.ac.in/sathee-railway-exams/student-corner/railway-gk/indian-railway-features/railway-canteens/] It conflicts with the real tenders below. Don't use it.
- One-time e-auction registration was ₹1,925 in an older report. [https://swarajyamag.com/news-brief/indian-railways-earns-over-rs-1500-crore-as-non-fare-revenue-through-e-auction]
- Food licence: FSSAI registration costs ₹100/year. A state licence costs ₹2,000–5,000/year, varying by state and business type. [https://www.professionalutilities.com/fssai-food-license-for-indian-railways.php]
- Estimate from a blog, not a regulator: an outside-the-station stall setup (cart, stock, deposit, signage, licences) is "under ₹3 lakh". [https://www.thebusinesslayout.com/business-ideas-near-a-railway-station-in-india/]

**3. THE LICENCE FEE (a fixed monthly cost) – real tender examples**
All amounts are the indicative annual licence fee, excluding GST. Bidders can quote higher.
- Small or mid station: Tea Stall GMU-29 on PF 4&5 at CLX station, ₹1,48,750 per year. Arithmetic: about ₹12,396/month. [https://www.ireps.gov.in/ireps/lease/pdfdocs/022026/86971608/viewNitPdf_5261085.pdf]
- Mid station: Tea Stall GMU-64 on PF 1 at EE station, ₹3,01,407 per year. Arithmetic: about ₹25,117/month. [https://www.ireps.gov.in/ireps/lease/pdfdocs/022026/86982525/viewNitPdf_5261629.pdf]
- Bigger 'A' category: Katpadi catering stall GMU-28, women's reserved, ₹18,83,200 per year. Arithmetic: about ₹1.57 lakh/month. It is a general catering stall, not only tea. [https://www.ireps.gov.in/ireps/lease/pdfdocs/022026/87021573/viewNitPdf_5264656.pdf]
- Vendor-side view, Amritsar ('A' category): an ordinary vendor pays ₹15,000 to ₹20,000 a month to the railways plus 18% GST. Some stall operators pay ₹3 lakh a year. That is vendor testimony, not an official figure. [https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/amritsar/rail-roko-protest-hits-hard-vendors-at-city-rly-station-549114]
- Escalation: The fee is fixed for the first 3 years and goes up 10% in year 4. Years 4 and 5 stay the same, with no other increase, even if the menu or tariff is revised. [https://www.tendersontime.com/india/details/tender-provision-catering-stall-gmu-42-chennai-egmore-ms-under-a1-category-railway-station-lo-63b89e3/]
